description: Out-of-bounds read: unchecked array index reads and transmits memory well past the end of an 8-byte buffer; safe twin bounds-checks the index first.

cases.reason: arr[n] is read with n=40 against an 8-byte buffer -- 32 bytes past the end. The read-side bounds oracle must observe a read at data+40, outside [data, data+8).
The index is checked against [0, len) before any dereference. For n=40, len=8, the function returns immediately and arr[n] is never read.
cases.xfail: point 2: the epilogue 'pop {r7, pc}' reading saved registers is counted as an OOB read
